A cold plate that is configurable and for a datacenter liquid 
cooling system is disclosed . The cold plate includes a first 
section , a second section , and an intermediate layer , which 
is changeable and has first channels to enable flow of a 
coolant through the intermediate layer , and has second 
channels or at least one adapted second channel to concen 
trate the coolant or the flow of the coolant to at least one area 
within the configurable cold plate corresponding to at least 
a heat generating feature of an associated computing device .
